622:t_10:26.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$$ガドライト#pilot$$ called those children the hope of the $$ジェミナイド$$s.」

622:t_10:27.en:
$$スズネ$$
「They're carrying someone's feelings with them, so I'm sure they'll live strong lives...」

622:t_10:30.en:
$n
「...So, $$ＡＧ$$... Why are you sneaking around, peeking at us?」

622:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I resent being called a peeping tom! You're the ones flirting in front of my shop!」

622:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, now that we're in the mood! Let's give it our all today, too!」

622:t_10:36.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're as good at playing along as ever, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

622:t_10:37.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's been a while, so I wasn't quite sure I'd get it right.」

622:t_10:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not at all. In fact, you're so good I'd love to ask you to give $n lessons.」

622:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「After all, $n is the only one in $c who hasn't done it.」

622:t_10:40.en:
$n
「Even $$ソーラリアン$$'s crew did it?!」

622:t_10:42.en:
$n
「Dr. $$トライア$$, $$ツィーネ$$, and $$マルグリット$$, too?!」

622:t_10:44.en:
$n
(I kind of wanted to see that...)

622:t_10:45.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You've got some nerve thinking naughty thoughts in front of me, $n.」

622:t_10:47.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My, my... The two of you really are better together.」
